'''Clayton Moore''' (GEMP handle '''Cmoore89''')<ref name="org2022">Email from Stephen Sanders to Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list for 2022).</ref> is a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. He is an administrator of the Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord group.<ref name="bb">Bill Bisco, personal communication, 12 October 2026.</ref>

The Nevada States Retro event used a modified Premiere – Reflections II card pool (no AOBS, no WYS).<ref name="nvann">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83672 Nevada States - Las Vegas December 16th, 2023], Batmouse, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 October 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012214021/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83672.html Internet Archive].</ref> After the first day's Retro rounds he stood fifth, with a 1–3 record.<ref name="nv">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1418421#p1418421 Nevada States - Las Vegas December 16th, 2023], Batmouse, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012214223/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83672-p4.html Internet Archive].</ref> At the 2026 San Diego Super Open Retro event he lost to the eventual winner, [[Eddie Szwabowski]].<ref name="nr" />
